parsed.name: 多维数据查看器
parsed.description: 用于实验数据可视化的非物理软件组件。它面向多维数据的过滤、重排与显示，可根据均匀或非均匀采样数据选择合适的数据展示方式，并支持导航轴及最高到二维信号图像的显示，适合在实验过程中浏览和检查多维测量结果。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component for experimental data visualization. It filters, reshapes, and displays multidimensional data, selects suitable display logic for uniformly or non-uniformly spaced datasets, and supports navigation axes with signal display up to 2D images. It is used to browse and inspect multidimensional measurement results during experiments.
